welcome.title: OpenCode Mobile
welcome.subtitle: Your OpenCode projects, wherever you are.
welcome.body: OpenCode Mobile brings your OpenCode server to your phone. Chat with coding agents, follow their work, and review changes across your projects.

server.title: Your server does the work
server.description: Models and tasks run on your OpenCode server. This app keeps you connected to them.

project.title: Projects and conversations
project.description: Projects keep chats, files, and changes together.

optional.title: Voice and task updates
optional.description: Voice input and completion notifications help you keep up with work on the go.

project.title: Choose a project
project.subtitle: Pick a project to start in, or add a folder on the server.
project.empty: This server did not report any projects. Add a directory on the server to get started.

permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.subtitle: Optional. OpenCode Mobile only asks when you choose to enable something.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.body: Allow OpenCode Mobile to notify you when a task finishes while the app is in the background.
notifications.unsupported: Notifications are not available on this platform.

voice.title: Voice input
voice.body: Microphone access lets you dictate prompts instead of typing them.
voice.unsupported: Voice input is not available on this device.
voice.deniedHint: You can still turn voice input on later from Settings › Voice & responses.

ready.title: You're ready
ready.subtitle: Review your setup and start coding.
ready.footnote: 你可以随时更改这些设置。

settingsAssistant.summary: 检查权限、连接、提供商、项目和偏好设置

general.title: 通用设置
general.subtitle: 按你的偏好设置 OpenCode Mobile。
